prompt: Create an original 90 second instrumental funk instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: clavinet, slap bass, tight drums, rhythm guitar. Style: sixteenth-note syncopation with short call-and-response riffs. Tempo approximately 118 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: An upbeat and groovy instrumental track featuring a prominent funky bassline, tight drums, and a catchy electric guitar melody. It has a modern funk/fusion feel.
description.zh: 一首欢快而律动的纯音乐曲目，以突出的放克贝斯线、紧凑的鼓点和抓耳的电吉他旋律为特色。它带有一种现代放克/融合的感觉。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
